```{r rolling-window-expt}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# 1. Define the experiment function
evaluate_rolling_window <- function(window_size, data = box_scores, n_trees = 300) {
  
  # A. Feature Engineering with variable window size
  features <- data |>
    arrange(team_id, game_date) |>
    group_by(team_id) |>
    mutate(
      hga = if_else(str_detect(team_home_away, "away"), 0, 1),
      efg = (field_goals_made + 0.5 * three_point_field_goals_made) / field_goals_attempted,
      tov = total_turnovers / (field_goals_attempted + 0.44 * free_throws_attempted + total_turnovers),
      ftr = free_throws_attempted / field_goals_attempted,
      ts  = team_score / (2 * (field_goals_attempted + (0.44 * free_throws_attempted))),
      
      # Variable rolling window: .before = window_size
      roll_pts_scored = slide_dbl(team_score, mean, .before = window_size, .after = -1),
      roll_oreb       = slide_dbl(offensive_rebounds, mean, .before = window_size, .after = -1),
      roll_dreb       = slide_dbl(defensive_rebounds, mean, .before = window_size, .after = -1),
      roll_ast        = slide_dbl(assists, mean, .before = window_size, .after = -1),
      roll_stl        = slide_dbl(steals, mean, .before = window_size, .after = -1),
      roll_blk        = slide_dbl(blocks, mean, .before = window_size, .after = -1),
      roll_tov        = slide_dbl(turnovers, mean, .before = window_size, .after = -1),
      roll_efg        = slide_dbl(efg, mean, .before = window_size, .after = -1),
      roll_tovp       = slide_dbl(tov, mean, .before = window_size, .after = -1),
      roll_ftr        = slide_dbl(ftr, mean, .before = window_size, .after = -1),
      roll_ts         = slide_dbl(ts, mean, .before = window_size, .after = -1),
      days_rest       = as.numeric(game_date - lag(game_date))
    ) |>
    ungroup()

  # B. Home/Away Differentials
  home_df <- features |>
    filter(team_home_away == "home") |>
    select(game_id, season, game_date, home_team = team_id, home_win = team_winner,
           home_roll_pts = roll_pts_scored, home_roll_oreb = roll_oreb, home_roll_dreb = roll_dreb,
           home_roll_ast = roll_ast, home_roll_stl = roll_stl, home_roll_blk = roll_blk,
           home_roll_tov = roll_tov, home_roll_efg = roll_efg, home_roll_tovp = roll_tovp,
           home_roll_ftr = roll_ftr, home_roll_ts = roll_ts, home_days_rest = days_rest)

  away_df <- features |>
    filter(team_home_away == "away") |>
    select(game_id, away_team = team_id, away_win = team_winner,
           away_roll_pts = roll_pts_scored, away_roll_oreb = roll_oreb, away_roll_dreb = roll_dreb,
           away_roll_ast = roll_ast, away_roll_stl = roll_stl, away_roll_blk = roll_blk,
           away_roll_tov = roll_tov, away_roll_efg = roll_efg, away_roll_tovp = roll_tovp,
           away_roll_ftr = roll_ftr, away_roll_ts = roll_ts, away_days_rest = days_rest)

  model_df <- inner_join(home_df, away_df, by = "game_id") |>
    mutate(
      target_home_win = factor(if_else(home_win == TRUE, "Win", "Loss"), levels = c("Win", "Loss")),
      diff_roll_pts   = home_roll_pts - away_roll_pts,
      diff_roll_oreb  = home_roll_oreb - away_roll_oreb,
      diff_roll_dreb  = home_roll_dreb - away_roll_dreb,
      diff_rol_treb   = (home_roll_oreb + home_roll_dreb) - (away_roll_oreb + away_roll_dreb),
      diff_roll_ast   = home_roll_ast - away_roll_ast,
      diff_roll_stl   = home_roll_stl - away_roll_stl,
      diff_roll_blk   = home_roll_blk - away_roll_blk,
      diff_roll_tov   = home_roll_tov - away_roll_tov,
      diff_roll_efg   = home_roll_efg - away_roll_efg,
      diff_roll_tovp  = home_roll_tovp - away_roll_tovp,
      diff_roll_ftr   = home_roll_ftr - away_roll_ftr,
      diff_roll_ts    = home_roll_ts - away_roll_ts,
      diff_days_rest  = home_days_rest - away_days_rest
    ) |>
    drop_na() # Drop initial games where window produces NaN

  # C. Train/Test Split
  train_data <- model_df |> filter(season < 2026)
  test_data  <- model_df |> filter(season >= 2026)

  # D. Recipe & Fit
  recipe_spec <- recipe(target_home_win ~ ., data = train_data) |>
    step_rm(game_id, game_date, home_team, away_team, home_win, away_win,
            home_roll_ts, home_roll_ftr, home_roll_efg, away_roll_ts, away_roll_ftr, 
            away_roll_efg, home_roll_pts, away_roll_pts, home_roll_tovp, away_roll_tovp) |>
    step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

  rf_spec <- rand_forest(trees = n_trees, mode = "classification") |>
    set_engine("ranger", num.threads = parallel::detectCores())

  wf <- workflow() |>
    add_recipe(recipe_spec) |>
    add_model(rf_spec)

  fit_obj <- fit(wf, data = train_data)

  # E. Predictions & Metrics
  preds <- predict(fit_obj, test_data) |>
    bind_cols(predict(fit_obj, test_data, type = "prob")) |>
    bind_cols(test_data)

  acc <- preds |> accuracy(truth = target_home_win, estimate = .pred_class) |> pull(.estimate)
  auc <- preds |> roc_auc(truth = target_home_win, .pred_Win, event_level = "first") |> pull(.estimate)
  kap <- preds |> kap(truth = target_home_win, estimate = .pred_class) |> pull(.estimate)

  tibble(
    window_size = window_size,
    accuracy    = round(acc, 4),
    roc_auc     = round(auc, 4),
    kappa       = round(kap, 4),
    test_games  = nrow(test_data)
  )
}

# 2. Test window sizes from 3 games to 25 games
window_tests <- 3:25

# Run the experiment across all window sizes with a progress bar
window_results <- map_dfr(window_tests, evaluate_rolling_window, .progress = "Testing Window Sizes")

# View summary table
head(window_results, 30)

```

```{r plot-window-experiment}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false


# Reshape for multi-metric plotting
window_results_long <- window_results |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(accuracy, roc_auc), names_to = "metric", values_to = "score") |>
  mutate(metric = if_else(metric == "accuracy", "Accuracy", "ROC-AUC"))

# Find the best window size based on ROC-AUC
best_window <- window_results |>
  slice_max(roc_auc, n = 1) |>
  pull(window_size)

# Plot performance curves
ggplot(window_results_long, aes(x = window_size, y = score, color = metric, group = metric)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = best_window, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkred", alpha = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = best_window - 0.8, y = min(window_results_long$score) + 0.01,
           label = paste("Optimal Window:", best_window, "games"), 
           hjust = 0, color = "darkred", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Accuracy" = "steelblue", "ROC-AUC" = "darkorange")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = window_tests) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Model Performance vs. Rolling Window Size",
    subtitle = "Comparing Out-of-Sample Accuracy and ROC-AUC on 2026 Test Season",
    x = "Rolling Window Size (Number of Games)",
    y = "Metric Score",
    color = "Metric"
  )
```


```{r training-seasons-experiment}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# 1. Build model_df ONCE using the optimal 18-game rolling window
opt_window <- 18

features_exp <- box_scores |>
  arrange(team_id, game_date) |>
  group_by(team_id) |>
  mutate(
    hga  = if_else(str_detect(team_home_away, "away"), 0, 1),
    efg  = (field_goals_made + 0.5 * three_point_field_goals_made) / field_goals_attempted,
    tov  = total_turnovers / (field_goals_attempted + 0.44 * free_throws_attempted + total_turnovers),
    ftr  = free_throws_attempted / field_goals_attempted,
    ts   = team_score / (2 * (field_goals_attempted + (0.44 * free_throws_attempted))),
    
    roll_pts_scored = slide_dbl(team_score, mean, .before = opt_window, .after = -1),
    roll_oreb       = slide_dbl(offensive_rebounds, mean, .before = opt_window, .after = -1),
    roll_dreb       = slide_dbl(defensive_rebounds, mean, .before = opt_window, .after = -1),
    roll_ast        = slide_dbl(assists, mean, .before = opt_window, .after = -1),
    roll_stl        = slide_dbl(steals, mean, .before = opt_window, .after = -1),
    roll_blk        = slide_dbl(blocks, mean, .before = opt_window, .after = -1),
    roll_tov        = slide_dbl(turnovers, mean, .before = opt_window, .after = -1),
    roll_efg        = slide_dbl(efg, mean, .before = opt_window, .after = -1),
    roll_tovp       = slide_dbl(tov, mean, .before = opt_window, .after = -1),
    roll_ftr        = slide_dbl(ftr, mean, .before = opt_window, .after = -1),
    roll_ts         = slide_dbl(ts, mean, .before = opt_window, .after = -1),
    days_rest       = as.numeric(game_date - lag(game_date))
  ) |>
  ungroup()

home_df_exp <- features_exp |>
  filter(team_home_away == "home") |>
  select(game_id, season, game_date, home_team = team_id, home_win = team_winner,
         home_roll_pts = roll_pts_scored, home_roll_oreb = roll_oreb, home_roll_dreb = roll_dreb,
         home_roll_ast = roll_ast, home_roll_stl = roll_stl, home_roll_blk = roll_blk,
         home_roll_tov = roll_tov, home_roll_efg = roll_efg, home_roll_tovp = roll_tovp,
         home_roll_ftr = roll_ftr, home_roll_ts = roll_ts, home_days_rest = days_rest)

away_df_exp <- features_exp |>
  filter(team_home_away == "away") |>
  select(game_id, away_team = team_id, away_win = team_winner,
         away_roll_pts = roll_pts_scored, away_roll_oreb = roll_oreb, away_roll_dreb = roll_dreb,
         away_roll_ast = roll_ast, away_roll_stl = roll_stl, away_roll_blk = roll_blk,
         away_roll_tov = roll_tov, away_roll_efg = roll_efg, away_roll_tovp = roll_tovp,
         away_roll_ftr = roll_ftr, away_roll_ts = roll_ts, away_days_rest = days_rest)

model_df_exp <- inner_join(home_df_exp, away_df_exp, by = "game_id") |>
  mutate(
    target_home_win = factor(if_else(home_win == TRUE, "Win", "Loss"), levels = c("Win", "Loss")),
    diff_roll_pts   = home_roll_pts - away_roll_pts,
    diff_roll_oreb  = home_roll_oreb - away_roll_oreb,
    diff_roll_dreb  = home_roll_dreb - away_roll_dreb,
    diff_rol_treb   = (home_roll_oreb + home_roll_dreb) - (away_roll_oreb + away_roll_dreb),
    diff_roll_ast   = home_roll_ast - away_roll_ast,
    diff_roll_stl   = home_roll_stl - away_roll_stl,
    diff_roll_blk   = home_roll_blk - away_roll_blk,
    diff_roll_tov   = home_roll_tov - away_roll_tov,
    diff_roll_efg   = home_roll_efg - away_roll_efg,
    diff_roll_tovp  = home_roll_tovp - away_roll_tovp,
    diff_roll_ftr   = home_roll_ftr - away_roll_ftr,
    diff_roll_ts    = home_roll_ts - away_roll_ts,
    diff_days_rest  = home_days_rest - away_days_rest
  ) |>
  drop_na()

# 2. Fixed Test Set: Season 2026
test_data_fixed <- model_df_exp |> filter(season >= 2026)

# 3. Define function to test different training lookback depths
evaluate_seasons_depth <- function(n_seasons_back) {
  start_year <- 2026 - n_seasons_back
  
  # Filter training data for the specified lookback window
  train_data_subset <- model_df_exp |>
    filter(season >= start_year & season < 2026)
  
  # Recipe & Model
  recipe_spec <- recipe(target_home_win ~ ., data = train_data_subset) |>
    step_rm(game_id, game_date, home_team, away_team, home_win, away_win,
            home_roll_ts, home_roll_ftr, home_roll_efg, away_roll_ts, away_roll_ftr, 
            away_roll_efg, home_roll_pts, away_roll_pts, home_roll_tovp, away_roll_tovp) |>
    step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

  rf_spec <- rand_forest(trees = 300, mode = "classification") |>
    set_engine("ranger", num.threads = parallel::detectCores())

  wf <- workflow() |>
    add_recipe(recipe_spec) |>
    add_model(rf_spec)

  fit_obj <- fit(wf, data = train_data_subset)

  # Evaluate on the fixed 2026 test season
  preds <- predict(fit_obj, test_data_fixed) |>
    bind_cols(predict(fit_obj, test_data_fixed, type = "prob")) |>
    bind_cols(test_data_fixed)

  acc <- preds |> accuracy(truth = target_home_win, estimate = .pred_class) |> pull(.estimate)
  auc <- preds |> roc_auc(truth = target_home_win, .pred_Win, event_level = "first") |> pull(.estimate)
  kap <- preds |> kap(truth = target_home_win, estimate = .pred_class) |> pull(.estimate)

  tibble(
    seasons_back  = n_seasons_back,
    years_trained = paste0(start_year, "–2025"),
    train_games   = nrow(train_data_subset),
    accuracy      = round(acc, 4),
    roc_auc       = round(auc, 4),
    kappa         = round(kap, 4)
  )
}

# 4. Test from 1 season back (2025 only) up to 11 seasons back (2015–2025)
season_tests <- 1:11

season_results <- map_dfr(season_tests, evaluate_seasons_depth, .progress = "Testing Training Depths")

# Display results table
season_results
```

best_depth <- season_results |>

ggplot(season_results_long, aes(x = seasons_back, y = score, color = metric, group = metric)) +

           label = paste("Optimal Depth:", best_depth, "Seasons"),

    subtitle = "Testing how many seasons of historical data produce the best 2026 predictions",
    x = "Historical Seasons Included (Start Year)",
    y = "Metric Score",
    color = "Metric"
  )
